hero_lead: Come as you are. There’s a seat for you at New Life Tabernacle.
word_lead: Pick the word closest to how you feel, and read a verse from Scripture for it.
watch_lead: Sunday Worship streams live on Facebook at @NL Tbkny. Full services, conferences and the Mass Choir are on YouTube.
pastors_lead: New Life Tabernacle is led by the Figueroa family, who have pastored this church since 1983.
attend_lead: First Sunday or fiftieth, there’s a seat for you on Bedford Avenue. Nobody will put you on the spot.
hello_lead: Planning a visit, need prayer, or have a question? Send it here and someone from New Life will get back to you.
in_person_text: Sundays at 12 PM · 1476 Bedford Avenue, Brooklyn
online_text: Live every Sunday on Facebook and YouTube
